svg.title: Cellulosome at the cellulose and bacterial interface
svg.desc: Schematic renewal of original ODP slide 33. CbpA bears a cellulose-binding domain and cohesins. Eight tan cellulosomal enzymes and one distinct blue EngE bear dockerins. Local cellulose interruptions illustrate engagement without measured lengths. Four branched hydrophilic contacts remain separate from the EngE route to its surface layer homology domain. Text attribution retained: Nature Reviews | Microbiology. Unmeasured conceptual geometry.
